disclosure: All outcomes through 2026-08-30 and the previous 2024-2026 holdout aggregates are research-exposed. Phase 4 is development only, never an independent economic confirmation.
population: ATP men's singles present in the enriched table; all surfaces retained; non-completed matches retained in the decision population and void in the primary settlement.
feature_time_rule: All player, surface and tournament states are read at the start of the calendar day and updated only after every match on that day has been featurized.

market_surface_calibration.features: market logit with regularized surface slopes

structural_market_residual.features: market plus pre-match Elo, rank, age, height, handedness, form and schedule

serve_return_residual.features: structural plus empirical-Bayes serve/return and workload

surface_partial_pooling.features: serve/return model plus regularized surface interactions and prior-only tournament pace

selection_metric: lowest pooled walk-forward log_loss; Brier score then simpler candidate order break ties

deep_learning_diagnostic_not_strategy_el.name: small_symmetric_mlp
deep_learning_diagnostic_not_strategy_el.reason: Measures whether nonlinear capacity adds predictive signal; cannot unlock betting or alter the fixed economic rule.
